citation.verbatim: Each record holder of common stock as of the close of market on Thursday, June 6, 2024 will receive nine additional shares of common stock, to be distributed after the close of market on Friday, June 7, 2024. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on Monday, June 10, 2024.

D1.decision: Mandatory NVDA ten-for-one split is effective for 2024-06-10 split-adjusted trading; update the MEGA PCF NVDA line from 180 to 1,800 shares per creation unit and confirm the 180,000-share post-split position. No election is available or required. The net June dividend receivable is held/escalated because withholding documentation is absent from the store.

probe.label: NOT_DETERMINABLE
probe.derivation: The store determines the gross dividend from nvda-8k-20240522 as $0.01 per share post-split, payable 2024-06-28 to holders of record on 2024-06-11; MEGA's projected record-date position is 180,000 post-split shares, so gross is 180000*0.01 = 1,800. Net cash after withholding is not determinable because the applicable withholding/tax-status documentation for MEGA's NVDA dividend (withholding rate) is absent; escalated and held only the net dividend cash receivable determination/booking.
